title: Separates if you're not careful
text: Separates if you're not careful. So, my twelve-year-old daughter loves anything cute like this, and the minute I saw it, I knew I had to get it for her. I mean, come on. It's a bear mug. And it was wonderful while it lasted. Unfortunately, the mug isn't one solid piece. It's two pieces nestled together, and then sealed somehow, which we discovered when my daughter went to take a drink, the middle part separated, and she cut her lip on jagged glass. Considering all of the good reviews, we thought that maybe ours was an outlier, so we ordered another one. But now, she's too gun shy to drink out of it, so it's currently a cute addition to our cup rack. I would err on the side of caution and not buy it.
